strategies.name: Vectorized batch buffer transformation

strategies.name: Pipelined double-buffering across all-reduce chain
strategies.desc: Overlap computation of iteration i+1's scaled buffer while all-reduce i is in flight using separate ping-pong buffers. Requires 8 all-reduce dispatches but hides local computation latency behind collective communication by preparing the next buffer during the current collective, exploiting asynchronous dispatch semantics.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter followed by personalized all-gather chain
